           OSTRYA VIRGINICA

         Ironwood


Of great value in anæmia from malaria. Bilious conditions and
        intermittent fever.



Gastric.--    Tongue yellow; coated at
        the root  . Loss of appetite.   Frequent nausea  ,
        with dull, frontal headache. Sickening pains.



Dose.--  First to third potency.
